name: Game UI Testing
purpose: Verify game user interfaces across controller, keyboard, and touch input: deterministic focus navigation, safe-area compliance on all target resolutions, localization robustness, and correct UI state transitions under real frame-timing conditions.
inputs: Target platform list with resolutions, DPIs, and aspect ratios
Input map: gamepad bindings, keyboard shortcuts, and touch gestures driving UI focus
UI screen inventory with focus graphs and state-transition diagrams
Locale list under test plus the localization pipeline
outputs: UI test specification document with screen inventory, focus graphs, and per-locale verdicts
Automated navigation and transition tests integrated into the game test suite
Screenshot baselines and pixel-diff report archived with the build under test
stop_conditions: All inventoried screens pass focus, safe-area, localization, and transition gates with evidence
Zero P1 defects open; remaining minors triaged with owner and milestone
